have h_main : lastDigit_postcond (n) (lastDigit (n) h_precond) h_precond := by
    simp only [lastDigit_precond, lastDigit, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt]
    constructor
    · -- Prove 0 ≤ n % 10 ∧ n % 10 < 10
      constructor
      · -- Prove 0 ≤ n % 10
        omega
      · -- Prove n % 10 < 10
        omega
    · -- Prove n % 10 - (n % 10) = 0 ∧ (n % 10) - (n % 10) = 0
      constructor
      · -- Prove n % 10 - (n % 10) = 0
        simp [Nat.sub_self]
      · -- Prove (n % 10) - (n % 10) = 0
        simp [Nat.sub_self]
  exact h_main
